name: izero-cli
description: Universal npm wrapper for izero-cli — a read-only terminal inspection tool for Isotope Zero memory engines. The postinstall hook provisions a private Python venv and installs the real CLI; the `izero` bin proxies through to it.
author: Isotope Zero

scripts.test: node --check bin/izero.js && node --check scripts/postinstall.js && echo parse ok
